name: Opportunity Flowchart
description: Two-column flow: value-added steps versus rework
whenToUse: When an existing chain needs sorting into value-added work versus rework — not for capturing a new process without that distinction yet.
emptyHint: No steps yet — use the toolbar to add a value-added or a rework step.
insertHere: Insert here — or drop a card here to move it
importHint: Pick a source. Its steps are appended to the end of the chain.
importEmptyHint: No matching source (SIPOC / Process Map) found in this project.

invariants.uniqueStepIds: Every step needs an id of its own.
invariants.uniqueSubstepIds: Every sub-step needs an id of its own within its step.
invariants.validExpanded: Only existing steps can be expanded.
